commitments.description: Google Cloud Beta Access Strategy - Submitted request for Chirp 3 Custom Voice beta access (Feb 8, 2026). Awaiting sales response Mon/Tue. DECISION: Wait 90 days before applying to Google for Startups ($350K credits) to build verifiable traction first (500+ users, 3+ months history, productive credit usage). Timeline: Reapply April/May 2026.

Lessons from Beta Access Application - Key learnings: (1) Don't brag about free credits (audit risk), (2) Human voice beats AI perfection in applications, (3) Timing matters - wait for traction before startup programs, (4) Never inflate numbers - Google can verify everything, (5) One channel at a time - don't spam. Decision framework: verify claims, 3+ months history, ready for scrutiny, waiting makes stronger.
